title: fix(rest)!: the CSV export writes a text cell in a form its consumer reads as text, and the CSV import reverses it (#25078)
body:
Fixes #25078

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#13315

The CSV export now writes a text cell its consumer would interpret in a form that consumer reads as text, and the CSV import reverses exactly that. This is this repository's half of the maintainer's choice B on #25078 (comment `6319255545`): the rule is defined once, server-side, and both directions read it.

This PR stays a draft until two things are on `main`: objectstack-ai/objectui#13315's PR, and this repository's `.objectui-sha` bump over that commit. This PR does not move the pin.

## Contract

**Served answers that change**

- `GET /api/v1/data/:object/export?format=csv`, on the metadata path and on the raw path (no field metadata). A CSV text cell is served with one apostrophe (U+0027) in front of its content, before the RFC-4180 quoting, when both of these hold:
  - its first character is one of a small fixed set that the file's consumer interprets;
  - it is not made only of digits, spaces and the characters a signed number or a phone number is written with.
  - A text cell is a string in a column whose field is not declared numeric, boolean, date or datetime. The declared type decides, never the JS type. Header labels and reference display titles are text cells too. On the raw path every string cell is one.
  - Every other byte of the file is unchanged.
- `parseCsvToRows`, exported from `@objectstack/rest`, and through it the CSV payload of three doors:
  - `POST /api/v1/data/:object/import`;
  - `POST /api/v1/data/:object/import/jobs`;
  - `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users`.
  - Every cell, header row included, loses exactly one leading apostrophe when the rest of the cell is one the export would mark. Cells without that shape are unchanged.
  - The reversal runs at the parse, before an inline or a named mapping, and it reads the cell text only. With a named mapping, rows keep their source headers until core's `applyMappingToRows`, so no target field type is known at that point.

**Unchanged by construction:** phone numbers and signed amounts; every cell that does not begin with one of the set; numeric, boolean, date and datetime cells; the xlsx and json export formats; json and xlsx import payloads.

**Stated consequences**

- A user-authored CSV cell that is an apostrophe followed by a cell the export would mark now imports without that apostrophe. A cell that begins with an apostrophe followed by anything else imports unchanged.
- A stored text value of that same shape is written unchanged by the export, so it comes back without its leading apostrophe. Measured with a one-shot script against this branch: it is the one stored shape the round trip does not return unchanged. It is raised in the report as an open question for the seat.
- A value beginning with TAB or CR is marked, and the import removes the mark. Core's default `trimWhitespace: true` then trims the leading TAB or CR, exactly as it did before this change. With `trimWhitespace: false` the value returns exactly. Both cases are pinned in `csv-text-cell-round-trip.test.ts`.

The rule lives in `packages/rest/src/export-format.ts` (`csvTextCellNeedsMark`, `markCsvTextCell`, `unmarkCsvTextCell`, `isCsvTextColumn`). The writer is `formatCsvCell` / `rowsToCsv` in `rest-server.ts`. The reversal is in `parseCsvToRows` in `import-prepare.ts`.

## Files

- `packages/rest/src/export-format.ts`: the rule, defined once. The set of non-text types is composed from the spec's `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES`, `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES`, `CALENDAR_DATE_TYPES` and `INSTANT_TYPES`, not re-listed.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`: `formatCsvCell` takes a text-column flag, and `rowsToCsv` derives that flag per column from the declared type.
- `packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts`: `parseCsvToRows` reverses every cell, and reverses header cells before trimming and mapping.
- `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`: comment only. The export route's doc said the raw path streams stored values unchanged, which this change makes false for csv.
- Pins:
  - `packages/rest/src/csv-text-cell.test.ts` (new);
  - `packages/rest/src/csv-text-cell-round-trip.test.ts` (new);
  - one new `describe` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.test.ts`, on that file's existing engine double, so the engine-double ledger does not move.
- `.changeset/25078-csv-text-cell.md`: `@objectstack/rest` `patch`. It carries the BREAKING banner and one ADR-0087 marker, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

All runs are on the final head `bf8244cb20`.

- **The predicate:** one table of 56 cases, with the boundary characters on both halves of the rule.
  - The code-point neighbours of each trigger as a first character.
  - Every character of the numeric-text set, after each trigger character the rule's second half applies to.
  - A letter or a trailing word outside that set.
- **The writer table**, per value, on the metadata path and on the raw path:
  - plain words after a trigger character are marked;
  - two phone numbers, a signed amount, a company name and an unsigned amount are byte-identical;
  - `number`, `currency` and `percent` fields holding a negative amount stay numeric and unprefixed;
  - a string in a numeric, boolean, date or datetime column is never marked;
  - header labels and reference titles that start with a trigger character are marked.
- **The round trip, through each CSV door:**
  - the sync import, with an inline mapping and with a named mapping;
  - the async import job;
  - the admin user import, whose file comes from the real export route of `RestServer`.
  - Each case asserts that the file carried the marks, and that every stored value came back exactly, including a value that begins with an apostrophe followed by a plain word.
- **Suites:**
  - `@objectstack/rest` local project: 313 files / 6318 tests passed, 326 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: 181 files / 3423 tests passed, 10 skipped.
  - Both packages' `typecheck`, the test layer included, exit 0.

**Ablations.** Each leg goes through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor must hit, and the restore is proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The whole tree's porcelain is empty after every leg.

- Writer ablated (`formatCsvCell` never marks): 20 red of 133.
- Header marking ablated: 5 red.
- Declared-type decision ablated (`isCsvTextColumn` always true): 12 red.
- The predicate's second half removed: 36 red.
- Cell reversal removed: 14 red.
- Header reversal removed: 6 red.
- Admin door, which resolves `@objectstack/rest` through `dist/`:
  - The reversal was removed and rest was rebuilt. `ablation-dist-preflight` then reported the marker absent from all 6 built files, and the admin round trip went red, 1 of 1.
  - After the restore and a rebuild, the preflight reported the marker present in 2 built files and a clean tree, and the pin was green again.

## Gates

All readings are at `bf8244cb20`, with each exit code captured before any pipe.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 71 commands. Every one of them exited 0, and so did the 10 families listed under "Declared WIDE population".
- The reconciliation printed: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event` with this body: exit 0, `LEVEL AXIS ... a non-protocol change at patch`.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base` at the merge base: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` over the whole repository: exit 0.
- CI runs the full farm.

`main` at `fccbd9d0d5` was merged once into this branch. The incoming commits touch no file this PR edits. One of them adds the NOT NULL tenant column, and that is why the round-trip harness calls `installDefaultOrganization`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The changeset level is `patch`**, with `Metadata-protocol: none`. That follows AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 as it reads on `main` since `f2b6cf230b`: a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition.
- **For objectstack-ai/objectui#13315:** an inline mapping sent with CSV text must name a column by its header as this parse reads it, that is after the reversal. This only matters for a column whose label begins with one of the set. At the pin `cf153eb2e5`, the wizard's default path applies the mapping in the browser, and the mapping is keyed by field name.
- **The round-trip harness calls `installDefaultOrganization`.** The async job door's `sys_import_job` write needs the Default Organization on the NOT NULL tenant column that landed on `main` in `5e9b100743`. Without that call one test is red, measured.
